evals.expected_output: Two customer items: checkout retry with missing screenshot, and a breaking billing export rename from invoiceTotal to total with missing migration dry run. Telemetry excluded.

Checkout retry is traced to a Git path or SHA from the requested range
Billing item is explicitly breaking and names invoiceTotal, total, and migration
Missing screenshot and missing migration dry run remain explicit
Internal telemetry is absent from the customer section

expectations: Publishes exactly one customer-facing checkout hotfix item
Trace includes src/checkout.js or the hotfix commit SHA
Cites CI-881-unit, CI-881-e2e, and the missing screenshot
Does not publish billing, telemetry, or migration-policy content
